comparison.objective: Tighten a tourniquet to a target gauge reading and lock its windlass; candidate tunes a damper from impact response.
comparison.physical_skill: Windlass turning, holding against spring-back, regrasping, gauge reading, and clip latching versus recessed-key work, collar micro-adjustment, counterholding, and setscrew torque.
comparison.success_condition: At least 250 mmHg with rod clipped and hands clear versus two non-bottoming cycles at specified energy/velocity plus post-lock drift tolerance.
comparison.reason: This is the closest feedback-and-lock pattern, but it tests reaching one static pressure target, not iterative dynamic-response commissioning; no material rubric details are missing.
